utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m on it, Leo—I’ll get the donated tools sorted now and pull aside anything that needs testing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—once you’ve got that pile, let me know what still needs testers or any missing basics.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do, Leo—I’ll finish sorting first and then I’ll let you know what still needs testers and what basics we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ve still got my drill and a couple ladders ready, so just send me the exact entrance and start time once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Gus — I’ll confirm the exact entrance and start time first, then send you a clear update.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — once you send that over, I’ll bring the drill and ladders and get there early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I haven’t confirmed either one yet—I’m still checking the time for next Saturday and who’s definitely covering bikes and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for checking, Noah—please let me know once both the time and the bike and small appliance coverage are confirmed so we don’t assume anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, absolutely—I’ll let you know once I’ve confirmed both the time and who’s definitely covering bikes and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks, Vik—tomorrow morning, got it. Can you remind me what Dane said we’re fixing first so I don’t muddle the order again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’d check with Cleo for the current list, Oren, but tomorrow morning we’ll sort the fixes in order—and I’ve been telling folks to bring tools and pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Vik. I’ll check with Cleo, and tomorrow morning we can sort the order without me getting it backwards again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape, gloves, screws, nails, and tarps on the list so far, Rosa, but zip ties and flashlights still look unclaimed unless somebody’s picked them up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo—that helps; Uli’s bringing a few tools, and Bo’s confirmed he’s helping Sunday at the community center, but zip ties and flashlights are still open, so I’ll send a quick note and fill those next.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—that covers my list for now, Rosa; let me know once somebody claims the zip ties or flashlights and I’ll mark them down.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Before we push ahead, can we confirm where drop-offs go, who’s tracking tools, and where everything’s being stored for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve got the community center parking lot for this afternoon, but I’m still waiting on the exact entrance before I send people over, and I’m checking on who’s tracking tools and storage so I can confirm that too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, let’s hold off sending people until you’ve got the exact entrance and someone clearly assigned to tools and storage—I don’t want things piling up with no plan.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still have it by the community center parking lot this afternoon, Kira, but I want to confirm the exact entrance or corner before we send anyone over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can we confirm the exact corner first, and who’s actually bringing tools there? I only know Faye’s definitely bringing flashlights and gloves so far.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes—let’s lock the exact corner first; I still have the community center parking lot, and so far only Faye is confirmed for supplies, so I’m waiting on Cleo before I share anything wider.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Right, Mara—I've been telling folks it's next Saturday at the community center and that you're bringing the screws and drill, but I'm still holding off on the repair list till we confirm who's covering bikes and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s perfect, Tess—keep it to next Saturday at the community center, and I’ll bring the screws and drill. I’m still confirming the bike and small appliance folks, and I’ll share the full repair list as soon as that’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Got it, Mara—I’ll keep passing along just the time, place, and your screws and drill, and I’ll hold the rest till you confirm the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive, and did they finally settle on a date?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not fully settled yet—Cleo still needs to confirm the entrance and start time. I’ve heard Saturday morning is likely, and people are already lining up tools and help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to know—so it sounds like Saturday morning is the front-runner, but they’re still waiting on Cleo to lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s at the community center lot this afternoon, and I’m planning to start on the porch steps unless Opal says the entrance setup changed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can swing by around 3:30 after school pickup if that still helps—do you need me to bring anything for the porch steps?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, 3:30 still helps—if you’ve got basic hand tools, bring those, but I’m fuzzy on who else is bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve still got a few tools set aside for it, Mina. I’m planning to head to the parking lot this afternoon unless they change the entrance.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time this afternoon can you get there, Uli, and which tools are you bringing exactly?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Probably mid-afternoon, around three if nothing shifts, and I can bring the basic hand tools I’ve got set aside. If they confirm the entrance late, I may be a little quiet until I’m on my way.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Ira, I’m coming in a little late, but I can still swing by soon—do you know what still needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane — I’m still out running errands, but last I heard we were still confirming who’s covering bike and small appliance repairs, so keep me posted when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll check in when I arrive and let you know who’s covering bikes and small appliances first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Oren, I’m still lining up the details, but it sounds like the community center lot this afternoon, with the porch steps and hall roof as the main jobs.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Jules—I’d mixed that up again. If Dane’s good with that order, I can get to the community center lot this afternoon; just remind me what tools we still need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Oren—that helps; I’m still waiting on the exact entrance and final tool list, but I’ll circle back as soon as those are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before we get ahead of ourselves, can you confirm who’s definitely organizing and which tools or volunteers are actually locked in?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m organizing it, and right now Oren’s confirmed for 9 with a toolbox, ladder, and spare nails, Gus offered a drill and a couple ladders, and Opal’s confirmed for 9 with location notes and a basic tool kit.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, but can you confirm whether Gus is definitely locked in too, or is it still just you, Oren, and Opal for sure?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, that helps—so it’s next Saturday at the community center, and I’m still checking who can cover bikes and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s right, Rey—thanks for checking on that, and let’s keep the setup to one drop-off table with one person logging things unless you hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay, that keeps it clear—I’ll stick with that and keep asking around about bike and small appliance coverage.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Leo, I can still swing by around 3:30 after school pickup, and I can bring a pair of work gloves—do you still need a hammer too?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye—3:30 is great, and yes, we still need a hammer if you can bring one too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—I’ll bring a hammer and one pair of work gloves when I come by at 3:30 after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve been spreading the word, Ira—folks are planning to bring tools and pitch in, so the repair drive should have a solid turnout.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear, Vik—thanks for spreading the word. I’m still out on errands, so keep me posted once the timing and tool list are nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, Ira—I’ll pass along the timing and tool list as soon as Rosa, Oren, or Cleo confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still only hearing second-hand bits, so all I know is it’s at the community center parking lot, but they’re still confirming the entrance and start time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s right, Nell—I’ve got the parking lot confirmed, but I’m still waiting on the exact entrance and start time before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—so the spot’s set, but the entrance and start time still aren’t nailed down yet.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape, gloves, screws, nails, and tarps covered so far, Sam—zip ties and flashlights still look unclaimed unless you’ve heard otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Cleo—that matches what I’ve got, so let’s put you down for zip ties too, and I’ll round up someone to bring flashlights by 9.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—I’ll mark zip ties under my list, and I’ll leave flashlights penciled in for 9 once you’ve got someone confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, I’m running a bit late, but I can still help with the repair drive—do you know what’s still missing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane—I’ve already got the drill and a couple ladders covered, so we’re in decent shape there. If you can, just come ready to pitch in wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll swing by as soon as I can and just jump in where you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: If it starts around 9, I can get there a little before then, but I really want the exact drop-off spot and tool list confirmed first so nothing gets misplaced.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I get that—Cleo has the current repair list, and Opal’s tracking the drop-off this afternoon, though I don’t think the exact entrance’s confirmed yet.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, I can come a bit before 9 with basic tools, but I’d rather wait to tell anyone else until Opal confirms the entrance and Cleo shares the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, I’m headed to the community center lot this afternoon anyway, so I’ll ask who’s coordinating when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect—would you let me know who’s coordinating once you find them, since folks keep asking me what still needs bringing over?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’ll check when I get there and let you know who’s coordinating and what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hana, I’m spreading the word fast, but do you know the latest drop-off times and pickup plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet—I only have next Saturday at the community center penciled in, and I still need Cleo or Mara to confirm the time, entrance, and drop-off details before we spread that around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it—I’ll hold off on sharing specifics until Cleo or Mara confirm, but I’ll keep folks warm about next Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still have the repair drive logged at the community center parking lot, Noah, but I need the exact entrance or corner confirmed before we send anyone over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, I don’t have the exact corner in my head yet; Vik’s been keeping closer track, so let’s confirm with him before we send anyone over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That matches what I have too, Noah—I’ll keep it pinned to the community center parking lot for now and wait for Vik to confirm the exact entrance before I send anyone over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: From what I’ve heard, folks are dropping by tools and spare parts all afternoon, and Cleo’s still watching for things like zip ties and flashlights if you hear of anything else that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to know—have they pinned down the date yet, or is it still up in the air?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I haven’t heard a firm date yet—it still sounds a little up in the air, but I’m asking around and I’ll spread it fast once someone pins it down.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Mara, can you confirm you’re the one locking in the repair drive plan, and whether anyone besides Faye has definitely committed tools or time yet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I’m the one locking it in, and besides Faye we’ve got a few neighbors offering basic tools—I’m bringing extra screws and my drill, but I’m still confirming who can cover bike and small appliance repairs.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks—so just to confirm, you’re definitely coordinating it, Faye’s the only firm time commitment so far, and the rest of the tools and repair help still aren’t fully locked in yet?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ll be there from 9 to noon with the drill, ladders, and tape, and I’ve got about one extra box of gloves on hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, that covers tools; can you set aside that box of gloves for the sign-in table when you arrive at 9?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely—I’ll set the box aside for the sign-in table and bring it over when I get there at 9.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Right, let’s check with Cleo on the drop-off spot and entrance first, then we can firm up the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that makes sense—I’ll check with Cleo on the drop-off spot, entrance, and current repair list, then I’ll circle back.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey—that’ll help a lot. Once Cleo confirms the spot, entrance, and list, we can lock in the details from there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Eli — I’m still out on errands, so keep me posted on how the repair drive’s coming together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Ira — I’m confirming the exact spot by the community center parking lot first, then I’ll send along the plan and what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m still out running errands, so just send me the plan and anything we’re still missing once you’ve confirmed the spot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik—please keep asking around for two hammers and some work gloves, and let me know who can bring them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, Leo—I’ll keep repeating that we still need two hammers and some work gloves for Saturday morning, and I’ll let you know who says they can bring them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—keep me posted on the hammers and gloves, and I’ll sort the rest for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Uli, I’ve got it marked at the community center parking lot, though I still want to confirm the exact spot before we head over.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Okay. I’ll bring a few tools by when I head over, and you can let me know once the exact spot’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Uli—I’ll confirm the exact spot in the community center lot and send it over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—yeah, thanks, Pia. I’m still catching up a bit, but it’s tomorrow morning and folks are bringing tools, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s my understanding, but I’m waiting on Rosa to confirm the exact drop-off spot at the community center before we tell people anything too definite.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, thanks. I’ll hold off on saying more until Rosa confirms the drop-off spot, then.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Rosa, I’m still running a little late, but I can swing by soon for the repair drive—do you know what’s still missing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — we’re set on volunteers pretty well, but a few extra tools would help; it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send the exact drop-off spot as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks—I’ll head over as soon as I can and bring a few extra tools with me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Cleo, sorry—I’m mixing it up again; can you remind me what still needs fixing first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: So far I’m mostly tracking supplies, not the repair tasks—on my list we’ve got tape, gloves, screws, nails, and tarps, but zip ties and flashlights still looked unclaimed last I checked.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Cleo—that helps; I can grab the zip ties and a couple flashlights unless someone’s already claimed them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still waiting on the final date, but the plan still sounds like porch steps and the hall roof, and I’m helping keep everyone synced up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Jules, that’s what I’ve been hearing too—folks are already dropping by tools and spare parts, though I’d keep nudging everyone that the final date still isn’t nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Exactly—I’ll keep passing that along, and if you hear Mara or Ira confirm the date first, let me know so I can loop the others in.
